meta.title: Nazar Zapolskyi — fast websites that sell
meta.description: Front-end developer: websites, landing pages and online stores for small businesses. No page builders, Lighthouse 95+.

hero.lead: I build websites, landing pages and online stores that load in a second, work great on phones and bring in leads. Clean code, no page builders, and an admin panel where you edit content yourself.

brix.text: A specialty coffee store with a passport for every lot, the BRIX Club subscription and a B2B channel. LiqPay, Nova Poshta, UA / EN — and the full purchase flow works even without JavaScript.

torq.text: A car service site: 4-step online booking on real free slots, a searchable price list of 184 services, a maintenance calculator and leads sent straight to Telegram.

ploshchyna.text: A renovation company landing: 13 sections the client edits on their own, a cost calculator and spam-protected lead forms. Responsive layout verified by automated tests at 11 screen widths.

services.lead: Pick a service and it goes straight into the request form. I fix the exact price in writing after the brief.

items.title: WooCommerce online store
items.text: A catalog with filters, LiqPay or monobank payments, Nova Poshta delivery, several languages and currencies. You add products yourself.

items.title: Company or service website
items.text: A multi-page site with online booking, a price list, case studies and reviews. Everything is edited from the admin, no code.

items.title: Landing page for ads
items.text: A single page that loads in under a second and turns traffic into leads. UTM tags and spam-protected forms.

items.title: Speed-up and site fixes
items.text: A Core Web Vitals audit, bug fixes, theme and plugin updates without breakage. A good way to get to know each other before a bigger project.

steps.title: Brief and estimate
steps.text: A short call or chat. I fix the scope, price and timeline in writing.

steps.title: Structure and design
steps.text: We agree on pages and look before the first line of code. I also work from your Figma layout.

steps.title: Site on a staging domain
steps.text: You see progress live, not in reports. We make changes as we go.

steps.title: Launch and handover
steps.text: I move it to hosting, set up email and analytics, and show you how to run the site. [X] days of free edits.
